name: 阮于軒
objective:
先修課程：負責教授同意。物質熱力學特性、改變能量形式之基本原理、熱力學第一及第二定律、可逆性與可用性、動力循環、冷凍循環、混合氣、化學反應。
Prerequisite: Consent of Instructor
Thermodynamic Properties of Substance, Energy Forms, The First Law Thermodynamics, The Second Law of Thermodynamics, Irreversibility & Availability, Power Cycle, Refrigeration Systems, Mixtures, and Chemical Reactions.
課程進度(1-16週):
第 1 週 	Introduction 
第 2 週 	Basic concepts of thermodynamics (I)	 
第 3 週 	Basic concepts of thermodynamics (II)	 
第 4 週 	Properties of pure substances (I)	 
第 5 週 	Properties of pure substances (II)	 
第 6 週 	Properties of pure substances (III)	 
第 7 週 	Energy transfer by heat, work, and mass (I)	 
第 8 週 	Energy transfer by heat, work, and mass (II)	 
第 9 週 	期中考	 
第 10 週 	The first law of thermodynamics (I)	
第 11 週 	The first law of thermodynamics (II)	 
第 12 週 	The first law of thermodynamics (III)	 
第 13 週 	The second law of thermodynamics (I)	 
第 14 週 	The second law of thermodynamics (II)	 
第 15 週 	期末考	
第 16 週 	Entropy 	 
第 17 週 	彈性學習
第 18 週 	彈性學習
